name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Premise.hardAt_of_reduction
title: Reduction accounting with a per-step overhead: Q with H bits gives P with k bits when 2^k (alpha + beta/p) <= 2^H
statement: Let Q have H bits. Suppose every machine A against P either has gain 0, or costs at least p and is matched by a machine B against Q with gain_P(A) <= gain_Q(B) and cost(B) <= alpha * cost(A) + beta. Then P has k bits whenever 2^k * (alpha + beta / p) <= 2^H. With a lazy simulation (generate each ciphertext item only when the adversary's input head reaches it) alpha is the per-bit cost of generating items, and beta (setup) is divided by the position p of the first item that can change the adversary's view, instead of the whole simulation time entering additively.
